description: 上证/深证指数日线周线 — Daily or weekly OHLC + volume + turnover bars for a major China A-share index: 上证指数 Shanghai Composite (000001), 上证50 (000016), 沪深300 CSI 300 (000300), 科创50 STAR50 (000688) from SSE; 深证成指 Shenzhen Component (399001), 创业板指 ChiNext (399006) from SZSE. Answers "上证指数000001最近10个交易日OHLC", "Shanghai Composite last 10 days", "深证成指周线", "ChiNext index history". Source: SSE yunhq public quote system (000xxx/999xxx indices) + SZSE ssjjhq history API (399xxx indices), both keyless.

days.description: Number of daily bars to return, 1-250 (default 10). Ignored if weeks is set.

weeks.description: Number of weekly bars to return, 1-104. Overrides days when set.
